briefing.opening: Good morning/afternoon. I will now begin the climate briefing for July 26, 2026.

sections.title: 🔴 Extreme Weather Sweeping the Globe and Its Impacts
sections.content: Today, the Korean Peninsula experienced extreme heat with a heatwave advisory in effect, and the highest level of severe heatwave warning was issued in the Gyeongnam region [35, 37]. Such abnormal weather is intensifying extreme climate polarization, exemplified by drought in Cheongdo, Gyeongbuk, and flooding in Andong, leading not only to 'climate anxiety' – a sense of helplessness due to heatwaves – but also direct casualties and property damage, such as water-related accidents and a surge in air conditioner fires [8, 11, 40]. Internationally, France and Spain are facing severe crises with the worst large-scale wildfires, forcing over 300,000 people to evacuate [36, 50], and climate change is now having an all-encompassing impact, threatening childhood summer vacations and even being recognized as a national security issue [41, 42]. The reality of workers being forced to commute on time amidst heavy rain and heatwaves demonstrates our society's vulnerability to the climate crisis, and analyses suggesting that climate change can disrupt human sleep patterns and even alter the landscape of California's wine industry indicate the broad scope of its effects [39, 43, 44].

sections.title: 🌱 Innovative Technologies and Adaptation Efforts for Climate Crisis Response
sections.content: Innovative technological development and adaptation efforts to respond to the era of climate crisis are actively underway both domestically and internationally. Notably, domestic research institutions, including KIST, are pioneering new advancements in climate change prediction by developing models that utilize Artificial Intelligence (AI) to forecast global ocean conditions in seconds and predict changes in the marine environment up to 200 days in advance [2, 4, 5, 6, 7]. In the agricultural sector, efforts to minimize crop damage from abnormal weather continue, with Jangsu County holding a field evaluation for multi-purpose sunshade nets, and Hampyeong County promoting temperature reduction technologies to prevent heatwave damage to floricultural crops [3, 9, 13, 14]. Internationally, nature-based solutions are gaining attention, with South Africa demonstrating how parks and community gardens can help cities adapt to climate change, and a couple in Boulder, USA, planting and distributing numerous trees in response to climate change [45, 46, 48]. Furthermore, adaptation strategies are being explored in infrastructure, such as methods for highway construction suitable for the climate change era [47].

sections.title: 🇰🇷 Accelerating the Transition to a Carbon-Neutral Society
sections.content: The Republic of Korea is making multifaceted efforts to transition to a carbon-neutral society. The Taean Haean National Park Office and the Blue Carbon Project Group have signed a business agreement for carbon neutrality, embarking on securing carbon sinks utilizing marine ecosystems [21]. Gyeongju City aims to create a carbon-neutral transportation city by supplying 457 electric vehicles in the second half of the year [23]. Daejeon City is also strengthening international solidarity, having met with the EU Ambassador to Korea to discuss expanding cooperation in science and technology and carbon neutrality [16, 22]. Meanwhile, carbon neutrality education is actively taking place in schools through activities such as the creation of green curtains at Okcheon Dongi Elementary School [19], and the Jeonnam Association of the Forest Protection Association is encouraging citizen participation by launching a carbon neutrality practice campaign [17]. However, challenges remain, such as the low penetration rate of key infrastructure for the carbon-neutral era like heat pumps, and ongoing debates surrounding the utilization of nuclear power [15, 20].

sections.title: 📰 Changes in the Energy Market and the Rise of Renewable Energy
sections.content: With renewed tensions in the Middle East and a surge in gas prices, international oil prices are soaring, causing significant volatility in both crude oil and renewable energy markets [24, 27, 30, 32]. This situation has stimulated investment sentiment in the renewable energy sector, leading to strong performance in related Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs), and expectations for AI power demand have also positively impacted the surge of renewable energy ETFs [27, 29]. Domestically, SK Eternix's activities are bringing a favorable trend to the solar power and power equipment markets [28], and Yeonggwang County and KEPCO KDN are accelerating the expansion of renewable energy supply by commencing public-interest solar power projects [33]. Furthermore, Inje County Council member Lee Soo-hyun has proposed an 'Inje-type renewable energy pension' to encourage local residents' participation and profit sharing, and Scotland is supporting 50 local renewable energy projects with 5.5 million pounds, demonstrating ongoing global efforts for renewable energy transition [25, 26]. Companies like Lotte Chemical are transforming into key players in the energy transition, moving beyond being eco-friendly power consumers to becoming suppliers [34].

sections.title: 🌍 Climate Action Through International Cooperation and Education
sections.content: International cooperation and educational activities are actively underway to raise awareness and drive tangible action on climate change. Domestically, 5th-grade students from Gimpo Gaegok Elementary School are engaging in video exchanges with Enrekang Elementary School in Indonesia on the topic of climate change response, fostering global climate action capabilities in the future generation [1]. Daejeon City is also strengthening international cooperation at the local government level, expanding collaboration with the EU in science and technology and carbon neutrality, and seeking practical exchanges with European cities [16, 22]. Meanwhile, positive news comes from Scotland's Cairngorms National Park, where the threat of a large-scale wildfire, which had lasted for 10 days, has been lifted, allowing evacuated residents to return home [51], and in Boulder, USA, a couple continues to demonstrate community-level climate action by planting and distributing numerous trees in response to climate change [46]. These educational efforts and international and local collaborations clearly convey the message that everyone must act together to confront the climate crisis.

briefing.closing: As we have seen in today's briefing, the climate crisis is a global challenge, and innovative technological development, international cooperation, and active participation from civil society are more crucial than ever. This concludes the climate briefing for July 26, 2026.

So how do they stay chilled and comfortable?Luis Pacherrez Antón is president of Agroperu Cooperative, a democratic collective of 102 small-scale farmers in the Chira River valley, Peru.
